rubric.name: literature-depth plan r2 implementability
criteria: Check parts 6–8 and the deferred part 10 against concrete phase predicates. Identify an observable failure for each concern.
Trace LD1 source support and comparability, LD2 conditional dependencies, and LD3 replay, coverage and stopping controls.
Trace LD4 independently checked semantic revision dependencies and LD5 claim support flows. Identify any missing or circular contract between phases.
Prioritize blockers to implementation or verification. Distinguish hardening and future completeness. An empty concern list is valid if the checked paths are named.
